description: Aires de livraison sur Mulhouse is a dataset listed in m2A open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Mulhouse. Localisation des aires de livraisons réservées à l'arrêt des véhicules de livraison Toute livraison à l'aide d'un véhicule ne peut être effectuée qu'en exécution d'une commande préalable. En cas de contrôle, le conducteur du véhicule doit justifier de l'existence de cette commande. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Livraison, mobilité, déplacement, transport, stationnement. The portal shows 197 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-mulhouse-alsace-fr-portal.
